LanguageData.CC_SetNote_RemoteTravellers: A remote home gets more travelers, each with a reason the map shows, and news of far towns.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_RemoteTravellers_Tip: How much a home's remoteness draws travelers. At 100% (the default), the most remote home gets up to 60% more camps (a daily chance of 8 in 100 instead of 5, and up to 30% less rest after one) and up to 60% more of Rimfolk's visitors, by its remoteness on the region map. A kind of camp that seeks something the land near the home has (a relic, a landmark, a sacred tree, ruins, books, its history, ore, grass in season, a road, the distance from every market) weighs up to three times as much there, and says why it came; travelers tell news of towns beyond the region at their fire, two pieces a stay at most. Needs "Systems talk to each other" for the rates. 0%: as before, and no news of far towns; why a camp came is still told.
